start.text: You crawl back into the neon ruins of the surface world. The Roman and Egyptian gods have combined forces into an unholy tyrannical coalition. They are using an ancient ritual to drain the lifeforce of every single infant in the lower districts to build an immortal sky kingdom.
start.name: System

choices.text: 🩸 Use your parasite's ultimate execution spell to violently drain the coalition's army, killing millions instantly
🧬 Manually hook your own heartbeat to the grid to act as a living battery, suffering perpetual torture to shield the children

apocalyptic_slaughter.text: You give in to total darkness. You command the Aurum Worm to release its ultimate curse. Across the entire hemisphere, millions of enemy soldiers and civilians explode from within as their blood boil transforms into razor-sharp gold needles. The streets run black with sludge. You laugh like a manic god amidst the planetary graveyard.
apocalyptic_slaughter.name: Musa

choices.text: Stride toward the cosmic core terminal

eternal_battery_check.text: You plunge heavy, red-hot copper cables directly into your open gold scar, routing the grid through your own nervous system. Every time the coalition draws power, your flesh burns and peels away, leaving raw metallic bone exposed. You are trapped in an endless loop of horrifying somatic agony, but the kids survive.
eternal_battery_check.name: Narrator

choices.text: Drag your skeletal frame to the final platform

abyssal_citadel.text: You stand atop the central spire. The skies have cracked open entirely, revealing a bleeding cosmic eye looking down at the ruined planet. The grand finale of your timeline has arrived.
abyssal_citadel.name: System

choices.text: ⏩ Step into the ultimate crucible of fate

end_of_chapter.text: Calculating permanent morality corruption variables... Syncing apocalyptic destiny arrays... Loading Chapter 14.
end_of_chapter.name: System

defeat.text: Your survival vitality hits 0%. The golden tracking runes on your skin shatter as your life force fades into the dark rain.
defeat.name: System
